error.title: The "{{addon}}" add-on crashed on this page
error.hint: The rest of the app keeps working. If the error comes back, disable the add-on from the Add-ons page.

installed.empty: No add-on yet. Find one in the Market.
installed.localHint: Put in addons/ by hand: the app never updates or removes it.

uninstall.title: Uninstall {{name}}?
uninstall.deleteDataHint: Its fields on drivers, cars, tracks… and its own database. Kept otherwise: reinstalling it brings everything back.

market.empty: The catalog is empty for now.
market.offline: GitHub can't be reached: this is the catalog shipped with the app.

link.label: Git repository
link.warning: This add-on hasn't been reviewed. It can access everything in RaceHubOS: only install add-ons from people you trust.

overrides.title: Core files changed by add-ons
overrides.replacement: {{addon}} replaces {{file}}: the changes from {{hidden}} are hidden.
overrides.orphan: {{addon}} changes {{file}}, which the core no longer has: that change does nothing.
overrides.hint: Disable one of these add-ons, or ask its author to wrap the file with @base.
